brief: Observability stack that actually catches incidents — 6 tools, real config.

slots.eyebrow: // the obs stack that pages you

slots.title: Collect everything
slots.subtitle: One agent captures metrics, logs, and traces without vendor lock-in.
slots.b1Body: Zero-code coverage for Node, Python, and Go services.
slots.b2Body: Single collector exports to multiple backends simultaneously.
slots.b3Body: Trace IDs flow across every microservice boundary automatically.

slots.title: Store time series
slots.subtitle: Scrape service metrics and define alerting rules that actually fire.
slots.b1Body: Slice latency percentiles by endpoint and status code.
slots.b2Body: Aggregate queries ahead of time for instant dashboard loads.
slots.b3Body: Global view across clusters with remote-write support.

slots.title: Indexless log search
slots.subtitle: Query terabytes of logs using labels instead of expensive indexing.
slots.b1Body: Filter by namespace, pod, and severity in milliseconds.
slots.b2Body: Extract JSON fields and calculate error rates from logs.
slots.b3Body: Jump from metric spike to relevant logs in one click.

slots.title: Distributed tracing
slots.subtitle: Follow requests across services to find the exact failing span.
slots.b1Body: Find traces by duration, HTTP status, or custom attributes.
slots.b2Body: Keep storage costs flat using S3 or GCS backends.
slots.b3Body: Correlate traces to metrics and logs using shared exemplars.

slots.title: Unified dashboards
slots.subtitle: One pane of glass for metrics, logs, traces, and on-call status.
slots.b1Body: Overlay Prometheus graphs with Loki annotations natively.
slots.b2Body: See firing alerts and drill into Tempo traces instantly.
slots.b3Body: Embed live dashboards for stakeholders without logins.

slots.title: Route incidents
slots.subtitle: Deduplicate, group, and send alerts to Slack, PagerDuty, or webhooks.
slots.b1Body: Route pages to the correct team based on severity.
slots.b2Body: Silence low-priority noise when critical alerts are firing.
slots.b3Body: Native PagerDuty integration with automatic escalation policies.

slots.ctaBody: Deploy this open-source observability stack in minutes with real configuration files and live examples.
